reviews.title: Guaranteed one-day shipping
reviews.text:
I ordered three gift cards for a friend who was moving and selected one-day shipping, with the gift cards set to arrive the day before she was due to leave, so she and her son had gift cards to use for meal stops along the journey. She was to leave in the morning, as one does when they are moving 15 hours away, but instead of having the gift cards with her they were still on the fedex truck until 12:30pm. The one-day "guaranteed" shipping did not happen. There was no bad weather. There was no holiday rush. When contacted about the delay, there was no reason for why they failed to be delivered by the promised time. Just that they failed to be dispatched with any promptness, and from then on failed to be treated with any of the urgency one might expect with "guaranteed one-day shipping".
I got my shipping fees refunded. Well that was nice of them, wasn't it?

reviews.title: recipients of gift cards are told the cards are invalid & they try to use them immediately
reviews.text: Over the past few months, I have purchase various gift cards for my grandchildren.  I believe one may have been Jersey Mike's, another Wild Buffalo Wings, and two from Starbucks.  When they try to use them, the retailers tell them they are not activated or valid and cannot be used.  So, I have spent all of this money, and the cards cannot be used.  I am not sure if they still have the older ones or if they tossed them when told they were invalid, but one for Buffalo Wild Wings and one of the Starbucks cards just got delivered today.  Can you please tell me what they have to do to have the cards be valid?  Your prompt attention toward a resolution of this matter would be greatly appreciated.  Let me thank you in advance for all of your time and help.
